ownerDecisions.decision: "Source + offline gates now": no root change now; CI runs the stdlib gates (ledgers, catalogs and pins, probe map, crate hygiene, expected.rs regeneration, probe-tree digest pin). Before each push the author compiles both musl targets locally and records rustc -V, the commands and the binary sha256s in the PR and attestation as author evidence, not CI evidence. The R12 Rust profile comes later, in one root bundle with Q-T4's jsonschema profile, before W06 needs binaries.
the installed Rust 1.99.0 tree, by its inventory sha256 97ebc29f…, is an allowed W04 tool input, recorded in each packet's attestation. It is a compiler, not W03 source; read no R10 file.
two packets: W04-4a CONF-ENF-004 (ledgers, catalogs, the LEDGER-E09 carry closed from both sides, the probe workspace, the 6 TG-05 probes) and W04-4b CONF-ENF-005 (the 15 TG-04 probes).

"Snapshot E-rows + confirm reading": snapshot docs/alpha-2/ENFORCEMENT_FEASIBILITY.md from harness-onion a2eab93 as a recorded addition (like Q-T5/Q-T7); rows E08, E07 and E11 become the TG-05 basis (and LEDGER-E01/E02 get a pinned source). The owner confirms the reading: the deadline is the signed UTC instant expiresAt, measured on the host's elapsed-time clock (BOOTTIME, which counts suspended time), and a wall-clock step neither renews nor shortens it.

"Decide in W06": W04-4a lists the exact permissions each case needs in matrix terms, adds the W06 blocker D-PROBE-ROUTE to every TG-04/TG-05 ledger row (it gates the run, not the source), and each report records the route and the policy digest. On an unmodified enrolled host the probes report NOT_RUN with EACCES/EPERM.

W04-4a design review = (a) "Fix + final round 6": apply D5-1..D5-3 and the notes, then run design review round 6 as the last design round. Its NOTEs are carried, and any MAJOR comes back to the owner (via me) before anything else happens.

D6-1 = (a) "Fix and build": apply the D6-1 fix (take the generation from the execution's last allowed exchange that names one; E07-GATE is NOT_RUN when none does; the README requires a generation on gate rows; the reviewer's runs become tests) plus the D6-2/D6-3 README MINORs and the cheap NOTEs. Go to the build without another design round; the packet's own review re-checks D6-1 first.
